text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the academy 
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! I'm sure you'll do great, Rob 
Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: D-Do you really think so...?
Ah! Taiki-senpai, Rob Roy-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Good morn-miler~☆ Ehehe, what were you two 
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Actually, you see... for her library 
committee duties, Rob Roy is going to give 
a presentation on a book! And in front of 
everyone, too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you're doing a book presentation, 
Senpai?! That's 100 miles of exciting!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
B-But when I think about speaking in front 
of so many people... I just get so 
nervous...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I want to do my best. Because I 
really want to share the wonder of books 
with others...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! If you want to fire 
yourself up, nothing beats... a deluxe 
steak!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Take a huge bite of freshly grilled meat! 
Motivation will surge right up from the 
depths of your body♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A v-victory meal... is that it? I see, 
that's very helpful.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
In that case, me too! My special method 
is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whistling! That always gets me fully 
pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Gran, does whistling set your heart 
on fire?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely! After all—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's my Mile-rule!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My Mile-rule: 'Pump yourself up with a 
whistle when it's game time!' Like in the 
waiting room before a race, for example!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that really is your usual routine, 
isn't it, Gran-san?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All of Gran's Mile-rules are so 
unique♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew! So refreshing~! Now that I've taken 
a bath, all that's left is my favorite—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
'End the day with a crisp, crunchy salad!' 
Time to dig in~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Still plenty of time before the 
next class!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
'Relaxation time listening to the Diet 
broadcast on the radio'! Hmm-hmm~☆

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gran is all smiles whenever she's doing 
her Mile-rules! It makes me beam with joy 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. They're personal rules just for me, 
to make sure every single day is the 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Personal rules just for yourself... I 
see, then—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Gran-san. ...I think I'll go reread the 
most famous scenes from my favorite 
adventure tale.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Reading that book always fills me with 
courage... I believe it will lend me 
strength!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that's wonderful! 'When you need 
courage, read your favorite novel'! That's 
an important Mile-rule of yours now, Rob 
Roy-senpai!

text_block_list.text:

for that person! Let's make some wonderful 
rules together♪
